classification: constructed-method support failure and forecast discrepancy
finding: We tested whether uncertainty about a past report's source changes retrospective updating. With a half chance of copying, an always-copy account rules out 41.1–41.3% of report probability across the retained settings. Independent reconstruction, all 1,120 paired strata and both complete replays verify this supplied-law constructed-method result. Learned provenance, historical process correspondence and human intent remain unestablished.
scope: eight retained development laws and two paired observation draws;true source metadata supplied in both posterior conditions;no practical-effect or human correspondence claim
